items.html: No structured claim model — v1's findings_claim_state / findings_claim_source is a worked example, deliberately NOT finalized from v1 (todo E6, a named open sub-area): per-emit vs per-finding claims, the open → resolved → verified lifecycle, claim-source as catalog vs template vocabulary → later

No digest on the operator/lifecycle ingress — the idempotency rung's digest branch is supplied by the actor-emit path only; a replayed operator intent with a different payload is still a silent Duplicate until those paths declare their contract identity (the warrant pattern: fields join at their own level) → later

No per-op payload schemas on the operator intents — decisions and action triggers keep their per-key schemas; generalizing the full emit-contract machine (vocabularies, cross-field rules, evidence obligations) to the operator ingress is a later unification → later

No extended authority fields — execution_id (an issued-context token), expected_round, handoff_id, state_fingerprint (todo E1's shape-derived family beyond role/version); execution_id needs issued-context kernel state — its own decision → later
No verify-evaluator governance beyond one run — evaluator freshness, allowlists, and cross-run evidence policy are the gate-library governance topic → L2
No deferred verify-gate currency mechanics — a deferred (async) verify gate must record and re-check its certified state across the wait; arrives with the deferred-gate lifecycle slice → L9
